rule_title: PostgreSQL must implement NIST FIPS 140-2 or 140-3 validated cryptographic modules to generate and validate cryptographic hashes.
check_text:
As the system administrator, run the following to ensure FIPS is enabled:

$ cat /proc/sys/crypto/fips_enabled

If fips_enabled is not "1", this is a finding.
